opportunities.title: Looking for a Startup Launch Consultant / Business Setup Specialist
opportunities.description: # Looking for a Startup Launch Consultant / Business Setup Specialist **Project: Build and Launch an Outsourced Business Solutions Marketplace for Indian MSMEs** I'm looking for an experienced startup consultant, business strategist or business launch operator who can help me conceptualise, structure and set up a new business from scratch. ### 1. Business Idea I want to launch a business that provides a wide range of professional services to small and medium-sized businesses (MSMEs) across India. The business will operate on an asset-light, freelancer-powered model. The concept is simple: - Identify common business requirements of MSMEs. - Offer these services through our own company. - Acquire customers through direct outreach, digital marketing and partnerships. - Source qualified freelancers and specialist agencies to execute the work. - Manage client relationships, pricing, quality control and delivery. - Earn revenue through service markups, commissions and recurring monthly contracts. Essentially, we will act as the single point of contact for businesses that need professional services without hiring full-time employees or managing multiple vendors. ### 2. Services We Want to Explore I want you to research and identify the most commercially viable services, including: - Website and e-commerce development. - Digital marketing and social media management. - Branding, graphic design and video editing. - AI implementation and business automation. - WhatsApp automation and CRM implementation. - Accounting, bookkeeping and MIS support. - Recruitment and HR outsourcing. - Business documentation and presentations. - Market research and data analytics. - Customer support outsourcing. - Engineering and design services. - Business consulting and operational support. You should not blindly include all these categories. Research the Indian MSME market and recommend which services have the strongest demand, margins, repeat business potential and ease of execution. ### 3. What I Expect You to Build I am looking for end-to-end business setup, not just a business plan or PowerPoint presentation. **A. Business Strategy** - Research the Indian MSME market. - Identify target customer segments. - Study competitors and existing service marketplaces. - Finalise the business positioning and revenue model. - Identify 10–15 initial services to launch. - Develop a pricing and profitability strategy. **B. Freelancer Supply Network** - Identify suitable freelancers and agencies across India. - Source freelancers through Upwork, Fiverr, Freelancer and other channels. - Shortlist and evaluate service providers. - Create a verified freelancer database. - Establish freelancer pricing, commissions and payment terms. - Develop onboarding and quality-control processes. **C. Service Packaging and Pricing** - Create standardised service packages. - Define deliverables, timelines and revision policies. - Calculate freelancer costs and our selling prices. - Design project-based and monthly subscription offerings. - Create quotation and proposal templates. **D. Business Infrastructure** - Recommend a suitable business name and positioning. - Set up the business website and service catalogue. - Create enquiry and requirement collection forms. - Set up a CRM and lead management process. - Create project tracking and delivery dashboards. - Set up invoicing, payment collection and freelancer payment workflows. - Prepare client agreements and freelancer agreements. **E. Customer Acquisition System** - Identify the best channels to acquire MSME customers. - Create prospect databases and lead lists. - Develop WhatsApp, email and LinkedIn outreach strategies. - Prepare sales scripts, proposals and pitch decks. - Create a repeatable customer acquisition process. - Develop a strategy to acquire the first 10 paying customers. **F. Operational Playbook** - Document the complete process from customer enquiry to project delivery. - Define how projects will be allocated to freelancers. - Establish quality checks and client approval processes. - Create escalation and issue-resolution procedures. - Build a system that I can independently operate after the handover. ### 4. Expected Final Deliverables At the end of the engagement, I should have: 1. A validated business model and market research report. 2. A clear business positioning and service catalogue. 3. A database of at least 30–50 shortlisted freelancers across selected categories. 4. Service-wise pricing and profit margin calculations. 5. A functional business website. 6. CRM and project management setup. 7. Sales and customer acquisition templates. 8. Client and freelancer onboarding systems. 9. Documented operational processes and SOPs. 10. A 90-day business execution roadmap. 11. A complete handover so I can independently manage the business. Where feasible, I also want you to help execute initial customer outreach and support the first few client acquisitions. Do not simply provide theoretical recommendations. ### 5. Ideal Candidate I'm looking for someone who: - Has experience launching service-based businesses or marketplaces. - Understands the Indian MSME ecosystem. - Has experience working with freelancers and outsourced delivery teams. - Understands business development, pricing and unit economics. - Can build systems and processes from scratch. - Has practical experience acquiring paying customers. - Can independently manage the setup and implementation. A consultant who has previously built an agency, outsourcing business or freelancer-powered service company would be ideal. ### 6. Engagement Structure I prefer a milestone-based engagement with clearly defined deliverables. Please share: - Your proposed execution strategy. - Relevant businesses or projects you have launched. - What you will personally execute versus outsource. - Estimated timeline. - Complete project fee. - Any additional operational or software costs. - What will be included in the final handover. **Important:** I'm not looking for someone to write a business plan and disappear. I want someone who can take ownership of setting up the business infrastructure, supply network, service offerings and operating systems so that I can take over a functioning business and focus on growing revenue. Looking forward to working with the right person.

opportunities.title: Servicios Legales Integrales para Protección de Contenido Digital y...
opportunities.description: Se busca un profesional o despacho legal especializado para gestionar de principio a fin la protección de contenido digital y la lucha contra la piratería de cursos online de nuestros clientes. El alcance del proyecto incluye: - Gestión de requerimientos y acciones de retirada de tiendas y sitios web que distribuyen o regalan cursos de forma ilegal. Esto implica contactar al infractor, al proveedor de alojamiento, al registrador del dominio, a Cloudflare y a la pasarela de pago. - Eliminación de contenido distribuido ilegalmente en canales y grupos de Telegram, así como en perfiles de redes sociales. - Obligar a la retirada de contenido específico de nuestros clientes, incluso si la web o el canal infractor permanece activo. - Iniciación de acciones legales, tanto por vía penal como civil, contra aquellos que no cumplan con las solicitudes de retirada o reincidan, en el país donde se encuentren, llevando el caso hasta su resolución final. El cliente proporcionará la detección de las infracciones, las pruebas necesarias y los informes técnicos. El profesional legal se encargará de la firma de documentos, la presión legal y la interposición de denuncias. Requisitos imprescindibles. Abogado/a colegiado en ejercicio (indica país, colegio y número). Práctica real en propiedad intelectual o delitos informáticos: cuéntanos dos casos de retirada o denuncia y cómo acabaron. Capacidad para denunciar fuera de tu país, con tu propia red de corresponsales. Tenemos casos abiertos ahora mismo en Perú, México y Colombia. No buscamos servicios de envío masivo de avisos dmca ni perfiles de cumplimiento normativo o rgpd sin práctica en propiedad intelectual. Cómo trabajaremos. Relación estable: cuota mensual para las retiradas y honorarios aparte por cada denuncia. Indica tu tarifa para cada parte y en cuánto tiempo mandarías el primer requerimiento. Para descartar respuestas automáticas, empieza tu propuesta contándonos el último sitio o canal pirata que conseguiste cerrar. Categoría: Legal Tiempo requerido: De 5 a 20 horas

opportunities.title: Long Term CAD expert
opportunities.description: I manage a continual flow of projects that call for fast, precise CAD work and I want to build an ongoing relationship with a specialist who can step in whenever new drawings or models are required. Typical assignments range from cleaning up rough hand sketches to updating existing CAD files or producing fully detailed 3D parts ready for fabrication, so versatility across 2D drafting and 3D modelling will be important. Turnaround times vary—some jobs need same-day edits while larger pieces may stretch over several weeks—but clear communication and consistent file naming are a must on every task. I use AutoCAD and SolidWorks most often, yet I am open to other mainstream platforms as long as deliverables arrive in the formats my fabricators and clients expect. Deliverables (as each job dictates): • Native CAD file (.dwg, .sldprt/.sldasm, STEP, or similar) • Dimensioned PDF sheets or plotted drawings ready for print or permit submission • If requested, high-resolution renders or exploded views for presentations Please let me know your preferred software, how you like to receive source information, and your typical response time so we can establish a smooth workflow from day one.

opportunities.title: Customer Service Toko Online
opportunities.description: Saya ingin memperkuat layanan pelanggan untuk toko online saya dan membutuhkan seseorang yang fokus menangani chat serta pertanyaan pelanggan setiap hari. Mayoritas interaksi datang melalui WhatsApp, Instagram, Facebook, dan marketplace seperti Shopee atau Tokopedia. Tanggung jawab utama: • Membalas pesan secepat mungkin, menjaga nada ramah dan informatif. • Menjawab seputar informasi produk, harga, dan ketersediaan stok. • Membimbing pelanggan mengenai cara pemesanan, pembayaran, serta pengiriman. • Menangani keluhan, retur, atau masalah pesanan dengan solusi yang tepat dan sopan. Harapan kerja: – Respons maksimal 5-10 menit selama jam operasional. – Gunakan catatan internal atau dashboard marketplace untuk melacak status setiap pertanyaan. – Membuat ringkasan harian singkat tentang jumlah chat masuk, isu yang terselesaikan, dan saran perbaikan proses. Jika Anda terbiasa berkomunikasi lewat WhatsApp Business, fitur DM Instagram/Facebook, dan panel chat marketplace, serta mampu menjaga kepuasan pelanggan, saya menantikan kolaborasi kita.

opportunities.title: Full-Stack Website Platform Overhaul
opportunities.description: Senior Full-Stack Developer — Complete Website Audit, Rebuild, Automation, CRM, SEO & Business Platform Integration Company: NEVIE-GLOBAL Websites: nevie-global.fr / nevie-global.com Project: Complete technical and commercial transformation of TWO existing websites Total Fixed Budget: USD 120 — Non-negotiable Payment: 100% AFTER complete delivery, testing and written acceptance Advance Payment: NONE Duration: Maximum 20 working days Location: Worldwide — Remote PROJECT OVERVIEW NEVIE-GLOBAL is looking for a highly skilled Full-Stack Developer or a small technical team to completely audit, repair, modernize, optimize, integrate and finalize our two existing corporate websites. Both websites already exist, with source code and infrastructure available. This is a complete technical, functional, commercial and automation upgrade — not simply a website redesign. The developer must reuse existing components wherever possible, correct defective functionality, complete missing features and deliver two fully operational commercial platforms. 1. COMPLETE TECHNICAL AUDIT — BOTH WEBSITES * Full source-code and architecture review. * GitHub repository and branch audit. * Frontend and backend verification. * Database structure and connectivity. * API and webhook inspection. * Hosting and deployment verification. * Broken links, buttons, pages and forms. * Authentication and authorization review. * Security vulnerabilities and configuration weaknesses. * Mobile and cross-browser compatibility. * SEO and accessibility analysis. * Performance and loading-speed evaluation. * Code duplication and technical debt identification. * Dependency and package review. * Error logging and monitoring verification. * Complete prioritized technical audit report. 2. FULL REPAIR, MODERNIZATION & UI/UX * Fix all agreed technical defects. * Restore broken or incomplete features. * Modernize website design and navigation. * Improve mobile, tablet and desktop responsiveness. * Optimize page speed and resource loading. * Improve typography, layouts and visual consistency. * Apply NEVIE-GLOBAL brand guidelines. * Repair forms and database connections. * Improve error handling. * Remove unnecessary code and dependencies. * Ensure consistent functionality across both websites. * Optimize accessibility and usability. * Deliver professional, production-ready interfaces. 3. SIX COMMERCIAL WEBSITE PACKAGES Implement and optimize the following packages: 1. Landing Page. 2. Starter. 3. Business. 4. Business Pro. 5. E-commerce. 6. Premium. Each package must include: * Professional presentation. * Complete features and benefits. * Approved pricing. * Comparison tables. * Optional services. * Functional quotation buttons. * Responsive layouts. * Editable commercial information. * Customer conversion optimization. 4. ADVANCED QUOTATION & CUSTOMER ACQUISITION SYSTEM Develop a complete quotation management process: * Dynamic package selection. * Customer and company identification. * Project requirements questionnaire. * Conditional fields and service options. * Budget and timeline information. * Secure document uploads. * Automatic request registration. * Unique quotation reference. * Email confirmation. * Administrator notification. * Customer request tracking. * Request status management. * Spam protection and form validation. * Data export. * CRM-ready structure. * Complete end-to-end testing. 5. CRM & COMMERCIAL AUTOMATION * Centralized lead collection. * Lead qualification fields. * Customer and prospect database. * Commercial pipeline tracking. * Automated email notifications. * Follow-up reminders. * Customer history. * Lead source tracking. * Dashboard of incoming requests. * CSV export. * API-ready CRM integration. * Duplicate lead detection. * Secure administrative management. 6. ADMINISTRATIVE DASHBOARD Build or improve a centralized administration interface covering: * Website content management. * Commercial package management. * Prices and options. * Customer inquiries. * Quotation requests. * Lead management. * Contact form submissions. * Basic website statistics. * User access and permissions. * Activity logs. * Error reporting. * Secure authentication. 7. SEO, ANALYTICS & CONVERSION OPTIMIZATION * Technical SEO audit and corrections. * Meta titles and descriptions. * Heading structure. * XML sitemap. * Robots.txt configuration. * Canonical URLs. * Structured data where relevant. * Image optimization. * Internal linking. * Mobile SEO. * Analytics integration. * Conversion event tracking. * Cookie consent integration where required. * Search engine indexing verification. * Basic conversion optimization. 8. SECURITY, PRIVACY & DATA PROTECTION * HTTPS and SSL verification. * Secure authentication. * Role-based permissions. * Input validation. * Protection against common web vulnerabilities. * Secure file uploads. * Secret and environment variable protection. * Database access review. * Basic rate limiting. * Security headers. * Backup verification. * Error logging. * Privacy-friendly form handling. * Integration of approved legal and privacy documents. 9. AUTOMATION & API INTEGRATION * Connect forms to automated workflows. * Email notification automation. * Webhook integrations. * API connectivity. * CRM integration readiness. * n8n integration where existing infrastructure allows. * Automated lead registration. * Automated customer confirmations. * Error handling and retry mechanisms. * Integration documentation. * Reusable workflow components. 10. INFRASTRUCTURE & DEPLOYMENT * GitHub code management. * Hostinger hosting integration. * Production deployment. * DNS configuration review. * SSL verification. * Database connectivity. * Environment configuration. * Deployment troubleshooting. * Basic automated deployment where feasible. * Backup and recovery instructions. * Production stability verification. No migration to Vercel. 11. INTERNATIONAL & MULTILINGUAL CONSISTENCY * Audit French and international website versions. * Correct translation inconsistencies. * Ensure coherent commercial messaging. * Verify language navigation. * Check localized metadata. * Maintain consistent branding. * Verify localized forms and customer notifications. * Ensure correct internal links between language versions. 12. TESTING, DOCUMENTATION & FINAL DELIVERY Required deliverables: * Full audit report for both websites. * Corrected source code. * Two operational production websites. * Six commercial packages implemented. * Complete quotation system. * Functional lead management. * Administrative dashboard. * SEO and performance improvements. * Security corrections. * Automation and API integrations. * Mobile and desktop testing. * Functional test report. * Technical documentation. * Deployment instructions. * Final demonstration. * All code committed to NEVIE-GLOBAL repositories. * 30 days of corrective maintenance after acceptance. STRICT PAYMENT CONDITIONS TOTAL PROJECT PRICE: USD 120 FIXED. * No advance payment. * No partial payment. * No upfront milestone release. * No additional development fees. * No mandatory paid third-party subscriptions. * One single payment after full delivery. * All deliverables must be demonstrated and tested. * NEVIE-GLOBAL must formally accept the completed project before payment release. * Payment must be handled securely through Freelancer.com. * Project funds may be secured through the platform’s escrow system, subject to platform rules. * All paid deliverables and intellectual property rights must be transferred according to the agreed contract. Do not apply if you require an advance payment or cannot accept the USD 120 total fixed budget. CANDIDATE REQUIREMENTS * Strong Full-Stack development experience. * Existing website repair and modernization. * GitHub. * Hostinger. * JavaScript / TypeScript. * React or equivalent. * Node.js and/or Python. * Database and API integration. * CRM and automation. * Technical SEO. * Web security. * Professional documentation. * Proven delivery experience. REQUIRED APPLICATION ANSWERS 1. Can you complete the entire scope for USD 120 fixed? 2. Do you accept one payment only after full delivery, testing and written approval? 3. Can you complete the project within 20 working days? 4. Have you worked with GitHub and Hostinger? 5. Can you repair existing code without rebuilding unnecessarily? 6. Can you implement quotation, CRM and administration systems? 7. Can you integrate existing APIs and n8n workflows? 8. Will you provide 30 days of corrective maintenance? 9. Are you working individually or with a team? 10. Can you provide verifiable examples of similar completed projects? Applications that do not explicitly accept the fixed budget, payment conditions and complete scope will not be considered. NEVIE-GLOBAL is looking for a reliable technical collaborator who can deliver complete, functional and verified results.

opportunities.title: Animator for Parenting YouTube Stories
opportunities.description: ## Hiring: 2D / 3D Animator for Parenting YouTube Videos We are looking for a creative **2D/3D animator or AI video creator** to produce high-quality, engaging animated videos for a new parenting and early-childhood development YouTube channel. ### About the Content Our videos will feature relatable, everyday parenting situations involving children aged 2–6, such as: - A child refusing food or throwing food from their plate. - A toddler having a tantrum in a supermarket. - A child hitting, shouting, or refusing to listen. - Children struggling to share toys or interact with others. Each video will explain the parenting challenge, what parents can do in the moment, and practical approaches to help children over time. ### Animation Style We are open to **2D, 2.5D, or stylized 3D animation**, including AI-assisted production. What matters most: - Cute, expressive characters with believable emotions. - Visually engaging, relatable parenting scenarios. - Consistent character designs across multiple episodes. - Smooth storytelling, natural movements, and polished visuals. - A warm, playful style with occasional humor. We are **not looking for basic slideshow animations or generic corporate explainer videos.** ### Project Requirements - **Video length:** 5 -10 minutes. - **Budget:** ₹5,000–₹10,000 per completed video. - **Volume:** Initially 2–4 videos per month, with potential for ongoing work. - **Deliverables:** Full HD videos with animation, voiceover, sound effects, background music, and editing. - Ability to repurpose footage into YouTube Shorts and Instagram Reels. - Commercial usage rights and original or properly licensed assets. AI tools such as Higgsfield, Kling, Runway, or similar are welcome if the final output meets our quality standards. ### When Applying, Please Share 1. Samples of similar 2D/3D animated storytelling videos. 2. Your cost for a complete five-minute video. 3. Which animation tools and workflows you use. 4. Whether scripting, voiceover, music, and revisions are included. 5. How you maintain character consistency across episodes. 6. Your typical turnaround time. **We are looking for a long-term creative partner who can help us develop a distinctive, recognizable animation style and produce high-quality videos consistently within budget.**

opportunities.title: Manual Login Testing Needed
opportunities.description: I want a clear-cut, manual verification of the login page on my website. The scope is intentionally narrow so you can go deep rather than wide: test the classic email-and-password flow only, on a desktop computer, using Google Chrome as the single target browser. Your job is to design well-structured test cases, execute them, capture every actual result, and flag anything that deviates from the expected behaviour. That includes checking how the page handles valid credentials, invalid usernames or passwords, and empty form submissions, plus confirming that success and error messages render correctly. Please document everything tidily and attach full-screen screenshots for any defect you discover. I need to be able to follow your steps and reproduce issues without guesswork. Deliverables • Excel file with all test cases and expected results • Test execution report showing pass/fail status for each case • Bug report (only if defects are found), complete with steps, observed result, expected result, and screenshots • Final testing summary outlining overall quality, coverage achieved, and any open issues I value concise, well-organised documentation over bulk, so focus on clarity and accuracy.

opportunities.title: Technical bag/carry-system design
opportunities.description: Project Details I'm looking for an experienced product designer to develop the design and technical documentation for a premium technical equipment travel bag. The product is intended to accommodate technical equipment, including laptops, mechanical keyboards, headphones and accessories. I have already undertaken customer research and developed an initial product specification. I'm now looking for someone to review and validate the product architecture, explore design concepts and develop a resolved design package. A key aspect of the project is the internal architecture, particularly the development of a structured, configurable modular organisation system. This may involve rigid or semi-rigid components, removable dividers and protective internal structures. The initial scope will include: Review and validation of the existing product specification. Product architecture and construction recommendations. Exploration of alternative design concepts. Development of the preferred design direction. Initial 3D CAD modelling and technical drawings. Material, component and construction recommendations. Technical documentation suitable for handover to a separate product engineer. Important: Physical prototyping and detailed production engineering will be commissioned separately in the UK. This engagement is focused on architecture, design and CAD development. Please share examples of relevant products you have personally designed, particularly technical bags, luggage, protective cases or products incorporating modular internal structures. Please also outline your proposed approach, deliverables and relevant experience.

Whether that means building critical pieces from scratch or tracking down and repairing faulty code, the primary goal is to restore smooth, error-free functionality as quickly as possible. Here’s what I need from you: • Rapid assessment of the current state (codebase, hosting, databases, APIs, front-end assets). • A concise action plan that outlines the fastest, safest route to a stable release. • Hands-on execution—coding, debugging, and deploying fixes or new modules—until the site/app runs reliably on production. • Clear, real-time communication so I always know what’s happening and can test changes immediately. Tech stack is flexible; if you’re comfortable with common frameworks such as React, Vue, Angular, Node.js, Laravel, Django, or mobile stacks like Flutter and React Native, that’s ideal. I’m open to your recommendations if another toolset will shorten turnaround time. Please respond with: 1. A brief overview of similar urgent fixes or builds you’ve handled. 2. The key technologies you’d lean on for this project. 3. Your projected timeline for first visible results. I’m ready to provide server access and any existing source files the moment we agree on the approach. Let’s move fast—looking forward to seeing this site or app back in top form.

opportunities.title: Ongoing WordPress/WooCommerce Development
opportunities.description: **Ongoing WordPress/WooCommerce Backend Development** I manage two established WordPress websites built with Avada and WooCommerce. I handle front-end design, SEO, digital marketing, and project management. I'm seeking an experienced, dependable backend developer for ongoing technical assistance as needed. **Immediate Priorities** Our primary focus is developing and refining membership, subscription, and digital product functionality, including: - WooCommerce membership and subscription configuration - Protected content, digital downloads, and access permissions - Membership levels and recurring payment functionality - Customer account management, renewals, and cancellations - Secure digital product delivery and payment gateway integrations - Automated customer notifications and transactional emails **Additional Development Needs** Future projects may include CRM integrations, workflow automation, API connections, custom PHP development, WordPress hooks, plugin configuration, performance optimization, troubleshooting, and general backend improvements. **Working Relationship** I'm looking for a reliable, affordable developer interested in a long-term professional relationship. Work will be assigned on an as-needed basis, with hours determined by project requirements, available client budgets, and the developer's hourly rate. I will continue managing the front end, client relationships, SEO, and overall project direction. The developer will focus primarily on backend functionality, integrations, and technical implementation. **Confidentiality and Initial Consultation** Before sharing client identities, proprietary information, project documentation, or website access, a signed Non-Disclosure Agreement (NDA) will be required. I would like to initially meet with qualified candidates to discuss their experience, technical capabilities, availability, and compatibility with our projects before assigning work. **Please Include in Your Proposal:** - Your hourly rate and general availability - Examples of relevant WordPress and WooCommerce development projects - Experience with membership and subscription plugins - Experience with custom PHP, integrations, and troubleshooting - Your willingness to sign an NDA I'm looking for someone who communicates clearly, works independently, respects deadlines, and can become a dependable technical resource as these projects continue to grow.

opportunities.title: Outlook Support Email Organizer
opportunities.description: I need an automated workflow inside our Microsoft 365 Outlook mailbox that will sort and label every customer-support email the moment it arrives. The sole focus is intelligent triage—no auto-replying—so my team can jump straight to solving issues instead of digging through an inbox. Current setup • All support messages land in a single Outlook address hosted on Microsoft 365. • We want each incoming email analysed and immediately filed, tagged, or colour-categorised according to clear, consistent rules (topic, urgency, order reference, or any additional cues you recommend). What I’m after You may build this with native Outlook rules, Power Automate flows, a lightweight add-in, or a custom script that uses the Microsoft Graph API—whichever delivers reliable, maintenance-friendly results. Non-technical staff must be able to tweak categories or rules without touching code, and the solution needs to run 24/7 in the cloud. Deliverables 1. Fully functioning sorting-and-labelling automation connected to our Outlook inbox 2. Short, plain-English documentation showing how to edit or expand the rules 3. A brief live or recorded walkthrough so the team can see everything in action When you respond, please outline your chosen approach, any similar Outlook/M365 automations you’ve built, and what access or information you’ll need from my side to get started.

opportunities.title: Ilustrasi Realistis Domba Terbang
opportunities.description: Saya membutuhkan satu ilustrasi digital beresolusi tinggi yang menampilkan seekor domba terbang melayang di udara dengan gaya realistis—nyaris seperti hasil jepretan kamera. Gambaran adegan yang saya inginkan: • Latar: hamparan padang rumput hijau berpadu pegunungan di kejauhan. • Pencahayaan & suasana: siang hari yang cerah dan damai; langit biru bersih dengan awan tipis lembut. • Subjek utama: domba tampak nyata, proporsi anatomi akurat, tekstur bulu jelas, sorotan cahaya alami. Detail teknis yang perlu dipenuhi: • Format akhir: JPEG dan PNG, minimal 4000 px pada sisi terpendek. • Versi terpisah tanpa latar belakang (transparent PNG) untuk fleksibilitas desain lanjutan. • Warna true-to-life, siap cetak dan tampil maksimal di layar. Silakan gunakan teknik apa pun—digital painting, 3D render fotorealistik, atau photo compositing—asal hasil akhirnya konsisten dengan deskripsi di atas. Berikan juga file sumber (PSD/AI/BLEND atau setara) agar saya bisa menyesuaikan jika diperlukan. Saya akan menilai karya berdasarkan realisme tekstur, komposisi seimbang, dan nuansa damai yang terasa natural. Jika Anda memiliki portofolio serupa, tautkan agar saya dapat melihat kualitas pekerjaan Anda.
opportunities.contractor_info: Demandante verificado en Freelancer.co (Anuncio #40816712, publicado hace 4 horas (hoy)). Presupuesto ofrecido: HKD 115 - 200.

opportunities.title: Industrial Electrical Engineer for AutoCAD Design
opportunities.description: Fully Remote | Contract | $8/hr We're looking for an Electrical Engineer with 3+ years of industrial experience to handle electrical design and documentation for engineered equipment and systems. What You'll Do - Create and review single-line diagrams, load lists, schematics, and wiring diagrams in AutoCAD Electrical. - Select and integrate motors, heaters, instruments, and PLC hardware. - Review vendor drawings and specifications against project requirements and NEC/IEC standards. - Work with vendors, customers, and internal teams on deliverables and schedules. - Provide remote technical support during fabrication, installation, and startup. Must Have - BS in Electrical Engineering or a related field. - 3+ years of industrial electrical engineering experience. - Strong AutoCAD Electrical skills. - Working knowledge of NEC and/or IEC standards. Nice to Have - Background in rotating equipment, skid or packaged equipment, OEM manufacturing, or power generation. - Experience with 3D modeling software. To Apply, Please Send 1. A short summary of your industrial electrical engineering experience. 2. One or two sample drawings or projects (redacted samples are acceptable). 3. Your availability.

opportunities.title: Social Media Lead Generation Management
opportunities.description: I run four sister companies—a traditional printing production house, an events agency, a fully serviced business centre, and a government service centre—and I’m ready to put our social channels to work. The first brands on the runway are the business centre and the government service arm; once we’ve built a steady flow of inquiries there, we’ll layer in the printing and events divisions. The single outcome that matters most to me is more qualified customer inquiries, whether they arrive as direct messages, WhatsApp chats, or phone calls. Every story, carousel, reel, or paid ad you craft should be engineered toward that conversion goal. You’ll own the full social funnel: strategy, content calendar, creative production, community management, paid campaigns in Meta Ads Manager, and performance tracking via native insights or Google Analytics. I’ll supply logos, service details, and on-site footage; you bring thumb-stopping copy, design skills (Canva, Adobe, or your tool of choice), and the data mindset to refine targeting and cost per lead. To shortlist quickly I only need one thing from you—proof. Share past pages, campaigns, or reports that show you’ve generated measurable leads for other businesses. A few numbers speak louder than a lengthy proposal. Pilot scope (first month) • Content plan and branded creatives for Facebook, Instagram, and LinkedIn • Lead-generation ad set optimised for “Send Message” and “Call Now” objectives • Weekly insights report outlining inquiry volume, CPL, and next-step tweaks If we hit the KPIs we set together, we’ll roll straight into a longer engagement and expand coverage to TikTok, YouTube, and Google Ads, plus include the printing and events firms. Show me your past work that proves you can turn impressions into real conversations, and let’s get started.

opportunities.title: Spa Email Automation Setup
opportunities.description: Email marketing setup for a spa & aromatherapy business (WordPress + WooCommerce) I run a spa and aromatherapy business in Austin, TX. My website is built on WordPress and has a WooCommerce shop and online booking. I need an email marketing system that brings clients back. What needs to be done: Newsletter signup Add a signup form to the site: a popup or slide-in plus a form in the footer, mobile-friendly Offer a discount on the first visit as the incentive, with a unique or single-use coupon code Use Mailchimp or MailPoet, depending on what you recommend for my setup Make the form GDPR/CAN-SPAM compliant, with double opt-in if recommended Automated emails Welcome email with the first-visit discount code Appointment reminder 24 hours before the booking Review request after the visit, linking to my Google Business Profile Rebooking reminder about 30 days after the visit, suggesting the client book the treatment again Optional: abandoned cart email for WooCommerce product orders Integration Connect WooCommerce and the booking plugin to the email platform so clients and their visits sync automatically Tag or segment contacts, e.g. “booked a massage”, “bought products”, “newsletter only” Design Simple, clean email templates in my brand style (calm, natural, spa feel) Templates I can easily edit myself later Deliverables: A working signup form on the site 4–5 automated emails, set up and tested A short video or written guide on how to edit the emails and see subscribers Requirements: Experience with WordPress, WooCommerce and Mailchimp or MailPoet automations Examples of similar work, ideally for spas, salons or other local service businesses Good English communication Mandatory requirement: local development only For privacy and security, all work must be done on a local copy of my website using Local WP or XAMPP. I will provide a backup of the site. No access to the live site will be given until the work is complete and approved. Before the work starts, you must send me a screenshot of my website running in Local WP or XAMPP. The screenshot must show the program window and the local address (e.g. mysite.local or localhost/...). The project starts only after I confirm that the site is running correctly in one of these programs. I may ask for more screenshots or a short screen recording during the work to confirm it is still being done locally. When the work is done, you will hand over the finished files or a migration package, and we will move the changes to the live site together. Bids that do not accept this condition will not be considered.

opportunities.title: Especialista en Marketing Digital para Ejecución de Estrategia
opportunities.organization: Cliente Oscar G. P. A. (🇨🇴 Colombia)
opportunities.description: Somos Industrias PAT-A S.A.S., Una empresa colombiana especializada en nutrición animal, en etapa de crecimiento y próximos al lanzamiento de nuevos productos. Ya contamos con identidad visual, manual de marca, página web, portafolio y una estrategia de marketing definida. Buscamos un Especialista en Marketing Digital con experiencia comprobable para ejecutar nuestra estrategia y fortalecer nuestra presencia digital. Responsabilidades clave: * Crear, configurar y optimizar nuestras redes sociales, incluyendo Instagram, Facebook, LinkedIn y otras plataformas relevantes. * Diseñar y gestionar el calendario de contenido mensual para todas las redes sociales. * Editar fotografías y videos proporcionados por la empresa, adaptándolos a los formatos y requisitos de cada plataforma. * Diseñar piezas gráficas atractivas y coherentes, siempre siguiendo estrictamente el manual de marca de la empresa. * Programar y publicar el contenido en los horarios óptimos para maximizar el alcance y la interacción en cada red social. * Gestionar y optimizar campañas de publicidad en Meta Ads (Facebook e Instagram) y Google Ads (experiencia deseable). * Monitorear métricas de rendimiento, optimizar continuamente las campañas y presentar informes detallados con resultados, análisis y recomendaciones estratégicas. La empresa proporcionará al especialista: * Estrategia de marketing digital ya definida. * Manual de marca completo y directrices de identidad visual. * Acceso a la página web y portafolio de productos. * Información técnica y comercial detallada de los productos. * Materiales gráficos y audiovisuales originales (fotografías y videos). Perfil requerido: * Experiencia demostrable en marketing digital y crecimiento de redes sociales. * Habilidades en creación de contenido y edición de video para plataformas digitales. * Conocimiento y experiencia en Meta Ads y analítica digital. * Familiaridad con herramientas como Meta Business Suite, Canva, CapCut o Adobe (deseable). Al postularse, se solicita enviar portafolio de trabajos previos, ejemplos de cuentas administradas, campañas ejecutadas, herramientas que domina, propuesta económica y tiempo estimado para iniciar. Categoría: Marketing Digital y Ventas Subcategoría: Community Management ¿Qué necesitas?: Marca mediana, nivel de interacción medio

opportunities.title: Virtual Assistant for Marketing Automation
opportunities.description: Virtual Assistant Intern (Client Emails, Proposals & Video Editing) I run a marketing automation consultancy, and I need a reliable remote VA to support me. The work includes sending emails and follow-ups to clients and leads, preparing proposals and presentations, editing short videos (reels, promo clips, client content), updating our lead tracker, and handling basic admin. opportunities.title: Super Realistic 3D Street Visualization
opportunities.description: I need a complete 3D scene of an urban street aimed at high-end architectural visualisations. The street must feel alive and convincingly real: detailed asphalt with subtle wear, marked parking bays, textured curbs, convincing road markings, realistic sidewalks, street furniture, dynamic lighting and reflections, plus a believable mix of parked and moving vehicles. Surrounding the roadway I want continuous rows of urban façades—shops, offices or apartment blocks—modelled and textured with the same level of care so that when I frame a camera at street level everything reads as one coherent environment. Daytime lighting is the priority, but the materials and shaders should react properly if I later introduce night or dusk HDRIs. Deliverables • Production-ready 3D file (Blender, 3ds Max, Maya or similar) with organised layers and named objects • All textures, PBR materials and HDRIs used, clearly linked • A short turntable or still set that demonstrates the final lighting and realism I’ll review the work on accuracy of scale, texture quality, lighting realism and overall cohesion of the scene. Let me know which software and render engine you prefer so we can align settings from the start.

opportunities.title: Home Interior D5 Renders
opportunities.description: I have a complete home-apartment model and now need a set of photo-realistic interior stills generated in D5 Render. I will pass you the source files and any reference finishes; your job is to light, texture, and render the scenes so they look ready for a magazine spread. If you prefer to start or refine the scene in Enscape before moving it to D5, that workflow is perfectly fine with me as long as the final output comes straight from D5. Please be ready to show past work that demonstrates you can achieve crisp, believable materials, balanced lighting, and accurate details—especially in residential spaces. Once we agree on views, I’ll expect the final images in high-resolution (print and web versions). Let me know how quickly you can turn around the first draft, how many revisions you include, and any file formats you need from my side.

opportunities.title: Laravel Developer Needed for Easy Inventory management work
opportunities.description: New Freelancer needed at Low Budget for Long Term. I’m working on an inventory-focused application built with Laravel and need an extra set of hands to push several improvements over the line. The core codebase is stable, but a few modules still lack the polish and functionality required for smooth day-to-day stock handling. Here’s the current situation: • Incoming and outgoing stock movements display correctly, yet the underlying logic for adjustments and returns is incomplete. • Product, supplier, and purchase-order models exist, though relationships need refining and validation rules expanded. • Basic reports render in Blade, but I want dynamic, exportable PDFs and CSVs generated through queued jobs to keep the UI responsive. Your role will be to extend the existing controllers, write clean Eloquent queries, create or tweak migrations where data structures fall short, and tighten up the user experience in the views. I’m on Laravel 10, PHP 8.2, MySQL 8, and use Git for version control; familiarity with these is essential.

opportunities.title: Sdr Freelance para Concertación de Reuniones B2b en España
opportunities.description: Buscamos un SDR freelance proactivo y orientado a resultados para nuestra agencia especializada en soluciones digitales, inteligencia artificial y automatización de procesos. El objetivo principal es concertar reuniones comerciales cualificadas con pymes españolas. Tu misión será contactar con empresas utilizando las bases de datos y contactos proporcionados por Whanga Media. Deberás despertar su interés en nuestros servicios y agendar citas con los responsables, sin necesidad de realizar presentaciones de venta ni cierres. Responsabilidades clave: - Contactar con empresas por teléfono y email. - Presentar de forma concisa nuestros servicios y propuesta de valor. - Concertar reuniones efectivas con tomadores de decisiones. - Realizar seguimiento de los contactos y registrar la actividad. Requisitos: - Experiencia demostrable en telemarketing o concertación de reuniones B2B. - Excelente capacidad de comunicación en español, con soltura para realizar llamadas en frío. - Alta iniciativa, organización y autonomía en el trabajo. - Perseverancia y habilidad para manejar objeciones. - Clara orientación a la consecución de resultados. Ofrecemos: - Colaboración remunerada con un fijo mensual más incentivos por resultados (bonus y comisiones). - Dedicación flexible de 1 a 2 horas diarias. - Presupuesto máximo de 500 euros mensuales. - Acceso a contactos comerciales cualificados. - Trabajo 100% remoto. - Posibilidad de establecer una colaboración estable y oportunidades de crecimiento dentro de la agencia. No se requieren conocimientos técnicos avanzados; proporcionaremos la formación, argumentarios y herramientas necesarias. Categoría: Marketing Digital y Ventas Subcategoría: Televentas Tiempo requerido: De 5 a 20 horas

opportunities.title: Instagram & Facebook Brand Growth
opportunities.description: My Instagram and Facebook pages need a consistent, strategic push so they start working as true brand-building assets. The priority is clear: build awareness and trust with people who live near my business. To do that, I want our feeds to showcase short, eye-catching videos and reels that feel native to each platform while still reflecting my brand voice. Here is what I see us working on together: • A monthly content calendar focused on reels, Stories, and occasional carousel posts, all optimised for local reach and high engagement • Creative production of each asset—scripting, design, editing, and on-brand captions with strong calls to action • Geo-targeted ad campaigns in Meta Ads Manager that amplify our best-performing content and drive qualified traffic to my DMs, WhatsApp, and dedicated lead forms • Weekly optimisation using Instagram Insights and Facebook Analytics so we can double down on the formats and hooks that grow the fastest • Transparent reporting every two weeks outlining follower growth, reach, saves, shares, and—most importantly—how perceptions of the brand are improving through comments and messages I’m happy to supply raw footage, product shots, and any brand guidelines you need. You’ll bring the creative polish, analytics know-how, and reliability to keep the schedule humming even when I’m busy elsewhere in the business. If this sounds like the kind of partnership you enjoy, tell me a little about similar local campaigns you’ve managed and the results you achieved. I’m ready to get started as soon as we agree on the first month’s plan.

opportunities.title: Evaluación de Impacto Socioeducativo
opportunities.description: Dispongo de una base de datos procedente de cuestionarios anónimos aplicados antes y después (PRE/POST) de talleres socioeducativos con adolescentes, y necesito convertirla en información clara, rigurosa y visual para presentar resultados institucionales. El alcance incluye: Cruzar y comparar datos PRE vs. POST: Emparejar las respuestas de antes y después mediante un código anónimo único por participante para medir la evolución real en empatía, percepción de riesgo y actitud ante el ciberacoso. Calcular indicadores clave y gráficos: Generar resúmenes visuales con porcentajes, comparativas antes/después y los 3 indicadores principales del programa (Índice de Tolerancia a la Violencia Digital, Tasa de Activación del Espectador y Mapa de Riesgo por plataformas). Flujo de trabajo sugerido:Limpieza y emparejamiento: Depurar los datos brutos (Excel/CSV), controlar códigos sin pareja, recodificar ítems inversos y garantizar la coherencia de la muestra.Modelado y visualización: Construir una plantilla reutilizable (en Excel avanzado, Power BI, Looker Studio, R o Python) que permita actualizar fácilmente futuros bloques de talleres.Segmentación: Configurar filtros dinámicos por Sesión (centro/grupo), fecha y plataformas digitales reportadas. Entregable ejecutivo: Entregar un informe visual exportable (PDF o PPT) con las gráficas listas para incluir en un dossier institucional, junto con una breve guía de interpretación y el archivo fuente automatizado. Requisitos valorables:Experiencia previa analizando cuestionarios PRE/POST o estudios de impacto social/educativo.Buen criterio de visualización de datos (gráficos comparativos limpios y fáciles de entender por perfiles no técnicos).Rigor en el manejo de datos anonimizados y capacidad para documentar el proceso de forma sencilla.

opportunities.title: WhatsApp Order-Booking Bot Creation
opportunities.description: I need a fully-functional WhatsApp agent that can guide customers through placing an order or making a booking without any manual intervention from my side. The flow should welcome the user, present the available items or time slots, collect their choices, confirm the details, and then forward the complete order or booking information to me in real time—email, webhook, or a simple dashboard are all acceptable as long as the data arrives reliably. Key expectations • Runs on the official WhatsApp Business API (or a reliable provider such as Twilio) so the solution stays compliant and scalable. • Clear, conversational message flows that can be edited later, preferably through a simple JSON file or visual interface. • Automatic error handling and fallback to a human hand-off when the bot cannot understand a request. • Quick setup: I would like the first working version live and testable as soon as possible. Deliverables 1. Deployable source code or cloud-hosted project. 2. Step-by-step deployment guide. 3. Short video or live demo that proves the ordering / booking journey works end-to-end. When you respond, include a detailed project proposal that outlines the tech stack, timeline, and any previous experience with WhatsApp Business API integrations.

opportunities.title: Financial Data Excel Analysis
opportunities.description: I have a sizeable set of financial figures sitting in Excel that I need turned into clear, decision-ready insights. Your task is strictly data analysis—no template building or VBA automation—using the full power of formulas, pivot tables, Power Query, or any native Excel feature that speeds up accurate number-crunching. I will supply the raw workbook along with a short brief on the business context. From there, I expect you to organise the data properly, apply the right analytical techniques, and deliver an easy-to-follow summary that highlights what the numbers actually mean for the business. Clean, well-labelled sheets, thoughtfully structured calculations, and concise visualisations (charts or dashboards where useful) are all part of the package. If this sounds like your day-to-day, let’s get started—I’m ready to review your approach, estimated turnaround, and any clarifying questions you might have.

opportunities.title: LinkedIn AI Outreach Assistant
opportunities.description: I want to put an AI-powered assistant in charge of my LinkedIn messaging so every potential client receives a timely, relevant reply without me living in the inbox. The goal is twofold: automatically handle all incoming messages and proactively search LinkedIn for new prospects, sending them a personalised introduction that feels human, not scripted. Key objectives • Detect any new message, comment, or connection request on my LinkedIn profile and generate a context-aware response that fits my brand voice. • Identify profiles that match criteria I will provide (industry, role, location, etc.) and start a conversation aimed at converting them into clients. • Keep a full log of all AI interactions so I can review, step in, or adjust the strategy whenever needed. I’m open to whichever stack you prefer—OpenAI / GPT, LinkedIn API work-arounds, Phantombuster, Zapier, Make, custom Python scripts—so long as the final workflow is reliable and remains within LinkedIn’s usage limits. Deliverables 1. A working LinkedIn assistant that runs autonomously in the cloud. 2. A simple dashboard or Google Sheet that tracks outreach, replies, follow-ups, and key metrics. 3. Step-by-step hand-off documentation so I can tweak prompts or targeting rules without touching code. I’ll supply the messaging style guide, prospect filters, and access tokens once we begin. If you have previous examples of LinkedIn automation or conversational AI you’ve built, please mention them when you respond.

opportunities.title: Comercial freelance a comisión en Madrid – Captación de negocios locales
opportunities.description: En The Why Reworks (TWR) gestionamos publicidad digital (Meta Ads, Google Ads y TikTok Ads) para negocios locales y marcas emergentes en Madrid: restaurantes, cafeterías, peluquerías, centros de estética, tiendas de moda, estudios de fitness… Buscamos comerciales freelance en Madrid que nos presenten negocios con los que podamos trabajar. TU TRABAJO - Identificar negocios de Madrid (preferiblemente dentro de la M-30) que puedan beneficiarse de la publicidad digital. - Contactarlos por teléfono, en persona o a través de tu propia red de contactos. - Conseguir una primera llamada entre el dueño o responsable y nosotros. El cierre, la propuesta y la gestión del cliente los hacemos nosotros. REMUNERACIÓN - 100% a comisión: 20% recurrente sobre lo que factura cada cliente que traigas, cada mes, mientras siga con nosotros. - Con nuestra tarifa estándar (400 €/mes + IVA), son 80 €/mes por cliente activo. Con 10 clientes activos, 800 €/mes recurrentes. - Sin objetivos mínimos ni horarios. TE DAMOS - Presentación del servicio, precios claros e informe de ejemplo. - Un servicio fácil de explicar: precio fijo, sin permanencias largas y sin promesas imposibles. BUSCAMOS - Residencia en Madrid o contacto habitual con negocios de Madrid. - Experiencia vendiendo a pequeños negocios (hostelería, belleza, retail…) o una buena red de contactos en ese sector. - Trato cercano y honesto. No buscamos venta agresiva. - Valorable: conocer el marketing o la publicidad digital, o trabajar ya con estos negocios (fotografía, diseño, distribución, asesoría…). IMPORTANTE: el contacto con los negocios debe hacerse por teléfono, en persona o a través de tu red. No se permiten campañas de email, WhatsApp ni mensajes en frío por redes sociales. EN TU PROPUESTA, CUÉNTANOS 1. Qué experiencia tienes vendiendo a negocios locales. 2. Con qué tipo de negocios de Madrid tienes relación o contacto. 3. Cuántas horas a la semana podrías dedicarle.

opportunities.verbatim_request: "En The Why Reworks (TWR) gestionamos publicidad digital (Meta Ads, Google Ads y TikTok Ads) para negocios locales y marcas emergentes en Madrid: restaurantes, cafeterías, peluquerías, centros de estética, tiendas de moda, estudios de fitness… Buscamos comerciales freelance en Madrid que nos presenten negocios con los que podamos trabajar. TU TRABAJO - Identificar negocios de Madrid (preferiblemente dentro de la M-30) que puedan beneficiarse de la publicidad digital. - Contactarlos por teléfono, en persona o a través de tu propia red de contactos. - Conseguir una primera llamada entre el dueño o responsable y nosotros. El cierre, la propuesta y la gestión del cliente los hacemos nosotros. REMUNERACIÓN - 100% a comisión: 20% recurrente sobre lo que factura cada cliente que traigas, cada mes, mientras siga con nosotros. - Con nuestra tarifa estándar (400 €/mes + IVA), son 80 €/mes por cliente activo. Con 10 clientes activos, 800 €/mes recurrentes. - Sin objetivos mínimos ni horarios. TE DAMOS - Presentación del servicio, precios claros e informe de ejemplo. - Un servicio fácil de explicar: precio fijo, sin permanencias largas y sin promesas imposibles. BUSCAMOS - Residencia en Madrid o contacto habitual con negocios de Madrid. - Experiencia vendiendo a pequeños negocios (hostelería, belleza, retail…) o una buena red de contactos en ese sector. - Trato cercano y honesto. No buscamos venta agresiva. - Valorable: conocer el marketing o la publicidad digital, o trabajar ya con estos negocios (fotografía, diseño, distribución, asesoría…). IMPORTANTE: el contacto con los negocios debe hacerse por teléfono, en persona o a través de tu red. No se permiten campañas de email, WhatsApp ni mensajes en frío por redes sociales. EN TU PROPUESTA, CUÉNTANOS 1. Qué experiencia tienes vendiendo a negocios locales. 2. Con qué tipo de negocios de Madrid tienes relación o contacto. 3. Cuántas horas a la semana podrías dedicarle."

opportunities.title: Expert Cabinet Vision Joinery Drafter
opportunities.description: I'm looking for an experienced Cabinet Vision Drafter to assist with ongoing commercial and residential joinery drafting projects. The ideal candidate must have strong experience producing accurate, detailed, manufacturing-ready Cabinet Vision models and professional shop drawings. I will provide project requirements, architectural drawings, construction specifications, drafting standards, and detailed instructions for each assignment. Your responsibility will be to independently complete the assigned drafting work, ensure everything follows the provided standards, and submit the completed deliverables for my review. This is a hands-on technical drafting role, not simply a 2D CAD drawing position. Key Responsibilities - Interpret architectural drawings, specifications, and joinery requirements. - Create accurate 3D joinery models using Cabinet Vision. - Prepare detailed shop drawings, including plans, elevations, sections, and construction details. - Develop manufacturing-ready cabinetry models with correct construction methods. - Follow provided construction standards, material specifications, hardware requirements, and drafting templates. - Work with Cabinet Vision UCS rules, parametric assemblies, and hardware libraries. - Ensure accurate panel dimensions, edge banding, drilling positions, clearances, and joinery connections. - Prepare production information, including cutlists and material schedules where required. - Identify missing information, technical conflicts, or potential manufacturing issues before proceeding. - Make revisions based on feedback and deliver final files within agreed deadlines. - Maintain consistency across multiple joinery units within the same project. Required Skills - Advanced proficiency in Cabinet Vision. - Strong experience in commercial joinery, custom cabinetry, kitchens, wardrobes, vanities, and fit-outs. - Excellent understanding of cabinetry construction and manufacturing processes. - Experience producing detailed, manufacturing-ready shop drawings. - Familiarity with Cabinet Vision UCS, parametric modelling, and customized libraries. - Knowledge of CNC manufacturing requirements and nested-based production. - Ability to interpret architectural drawings and work accurately with metric dimensions. - Strong attention to detail and ability to work independently. - Reliable communication and timely delivery. Preferred Qualifications - Experience working with commercial joinery or cabinet manufacturing companies. - Experience with complex commercial fit-outs and custom joinery. - Ability to understand and adapt quickly to established construction standards. - Experience with AutoCAD. - Familiarity with materials such as melamine, laminate, MDF, timber veneer, and stone. Workflow 1. I will provide the project drawings, specifications, construction standards, and expected deliverables. 2. You will review the requirements and raise any questions before starting. 3. You will complete the Cabinet Vision models and shop drawings independently. 4. You will submit the completed files for my review. 5. You will make any necessary corrections and provide the final deliverables. All work must follow the supplied construction standards and be suitable for manufacturing. Expected Deliverables - Cabinet Vision project files and models. - Complete shop drawing sets in PDF format. - Plans, elevations, sections, and construction details. - Material and hardware specifications. - Manufacturing-ready production information, as required. - Revised and finalized project files. Application Requirements Please include the following information in your proposal: 1. How many years of experience do you have with Cabinet Vision? 2. Which version of Cabinet Vision do you currently use? 3. Have you worked on commercial joinery or custom cabinetry projects? 4. Are you experienced with UCS rules and customized construction libraries? 5. Can you provide samples of your previous Cabinet Vision shop drawings? 6. What is your hourly rate and weekly availability? 7. Are you comfortable working independently from detailed written specifications? Important: Please provide actual Cabinet Vision work samples demonstrating your ability to produce accurate, manufacturing-ready joinery drawings. I'm looking for someone reliable, technically skilled, detail-oriented, and interested in a long-term working relationship.

This role requires ownership of the **complete sales cycle**, from identifying qualified prospects and initiating conversations to negotiating proposals and closing deals. **Responsibilities** - Identify and engage relevant businesses and decision-makers. - Generate qualified leads through targeted outbound prospecting. - Understand client needs and communicate the value of our software. - Coordinate sales meetings and product demonstrations with our team. - Manage proposals, follow-ups, negotiations, and deal closure. - Maintain an accurate pipeline and provide regular progress updates. **Experience and Skills** - **3–5 years of successful B2B sales experience**, preferably in SaaS, business automation, or technology solutions. - A demonstrated track record of winning clients and closing deals. - Experience selling into one or more of our target markets. - Strong communication, relationship-building, and negotiation skills. - Ability to work independently and take responsibility for sales outcomes. **Compensation and Working Arrangement** - **Fixed monthly compensation: USD $133.** - **Additional commission: 2% on each successfully closed deal.** - Part-time, remote engagement with flexible working hours. - Manage your own schedule while accommodating prospect meetings and agreed commitments. - Contract continuation will depend solely on results against mutually agreed sales targets. Outreach activity alone will not determine renewal. **To Apply** Please share your relevant sales experience, markets served, examples of measurable results, and how you would approach your first 30 days. Include your availability and confirmation that the stated compensation structure fits your expectations.

opportunities.title: Build Private Local AI Business Assistant
opportunities.description: **Title: Developer Needed – Private Local AI Business Assistant ** I am looking for an experienced Python / AI Automation Developer to help build a private, local-first AI assistant for my manufacturing company in India. I will install Ollama myself. I need development starting from the integration and automation stage. **Initial scope:** 1. Email integration (Gmail / Microsoft 365): read multiple authorized accounts, prioritize important emails and generate daily summaries. 2. Generate TXT files containing suggested replies to the 3 most important emails (never send automatically). 3. Odoo 18 Enterprise integration: read customer orders, identify anomalies, track salespeople and generate daily order/production reports. 4. Bank statement processing: read PDF/Excel statements and generate separate Excel files for income and expenses. 5. Local company knowledge base: automatically organize information into folders and structured files. 6. Local document generation and reporting. **Future phases:** - WhatsApp Business API integration: customer complaints, refund requests, unanswered messages and order tracking. - Automated customer support with restricted permissions. - TallyPrime proforma invoice preparation. - Advanced business workflows. **Technical and security requirements:** - AI inference and document processing must run locally. - No uploading company documents to external AI APIs or cloud AI services. - All source code must be delivered to a company-owned GitHub repository. - Full documentation and installation instructions required. - No hidden remote access, backdoors or proprietary dependencies. - NDA and full intellectual property transfer required. - Development initially using dummy/anonymized data. **Please provide:** - Relevant previous projects. - Proposed technical architecture. - Estimated development time. - Fixed-price quote for each milestone. - Hourly rate for future maintenance. I prefer a phased project with clear deliverables rather than a complete system developed all at once.

opportunities.title: Parkhurst QLD Australia RPEQ-Linked Subdivision Civil Design
opportunities.description: I’m progressing a Queensland operational works submission for a new subdivision and have reached the point where full civil design is required. Concept plans are already prepared; what I now need is the complete detailed design package that turns those concepts into council-ready, RPEQ-signed drawings. The project involves a subdivision with drainage, sewer, water services, roads, utilities and associated earthworks, all to be delivered under current Australian Standards, QUDM, IPWEAQ and local council guidelines. Whether you hold the RPEQ yourself or collaborate closely with someone who does, the end result must be drawings and calculations ready for formal lodgement and approval in Queensland. AutoCAD Civil 3D (or 12d), DRAINS, MUSIC and similar industry tools are the expected platforms so the files integrate smoothly with council requirements. Acceptance of the work hinges on the following discrete deliverables: • Full set of operational works drawings (roads, kerbs, stormwater, sewer, water, earthworks) in DWG and PDF • Design reports and hydraulic/hydrologic calculations that match the drawings • Compliance notes demonstrating adherence to relevant Australian and QLD codes • RPEQ certification on the cover sheet and any documents that require it Provide a brief outline of your proposed workflow, the RPEQ arrangement you have in place, and the software you intend to use, and we can move straight into the detailed design phase.

opportunities.title: Gearbox Actuator Design & ANSYS -- 2
opportunities.description: I’m developing a compact gearbox-based actuator and need a mechanical engineer who can carry the concept all the way through detailed verification in ANSYS. Your job starts with refining my preliminary sketches (or proposing your own concept if it proves better), modelling each gear, shaft, housing and bearing, and then setting up all necessary simulations inside ANSYS Workbench. The core objective is to confirm the design’s reliability under realistic loads: bending and torsion on the shafts, contact stresses on the gears, bolt preload in the housing, and overall deformation. Alongside static strength, I also want to see motion behaviour over a full duty cycle so I can verify backlash, efficiency and potential resonance points. If you already have macros or scripts that speed up these studies, all the better. Once the results are in, I’ll need recommendations on material grades, surface treatments and any geometric tweaks that improve durability or reduce weight without driving up machining costs. Organise the findings clearly—screen grabs, contour plots, safety factors—so they can be dropped straight into my project file and shown to the machinist. Deliverables • Parametric 3D CAD files (STEP or native SolidWorks/Inventor) • Complete ANSYS workbench file(s) with solved studies • PDF report summarising loads, boundary conditions, assumptions, results and design changes • Final manufacturing drawings with tolerances, fits and a revision block I will be available daily for quick clarifications and can share load specs, space constraints and photos of the surrounding assembly on request. Let me know your preferred CAD package, ANSYS version and estimated turnaround time so we can lock in milestones right away. opportunities.title: Barbershop Walk-In Queue Management System
opportunities.description: Hello, I can build a custom **Barbershop Walk-In Check-In & Queue Management System** that keeps your barbers' workflow simple while giving you complete control over walk-ins and customer data. opportunities.title: Automated IQ Option Copy Trading
opportunities.description: I need a fully-automated solution that connects to IQ Option, watches several specific traders of my choosing, determines which one is currently performing best, and mirrors every new position to my own account instantly without pausing for manual approval. Key points of the workflow • The tool must track multiple traders in real time, continuously updating performance statistics so it can switch to the top performer whenever results shift. • Once the best trader is identified, every trade they open should be duplicated in my account with identical parameters (instrument, direction, stake, expiry, etc.) the moment the order is placed. • I want the list of traders to be editable and the performance comparison logic to be clearly documented so I can refine the criteria later if needed. Deliverables 1. Source code for the copy-trading bot (Python, Node, or another widely supported language that works with IQ Option’s API or websocket). 2. Simple configuration file or UI where I enter the trader IDs I wish to monitor. 3. Installation guide plus a brief video or screenshots showing the bot in action on a demo account to confirm it switches traders correctly and executes copied orders without delay. Acceptance criteria • Latency between the original and copied trade stays under two seconds. • Bot runs unattended for at least eight continuous hours without crashing. • Detailed log file records which trader was followed and every trade replicated.

opportunities.title: Personal Errand & Task Organizer
opportunities.description: My days move fast and I need a detail-minded organiser to keep my personal life running just as smoothly. The core focus is arranging and tracking all of my shopping, bookings, and appointments so nothing is ever missed or double-booked. Here’s what the work looks like day to day: you will confirm doctor or salon slots, place online orders, chase delivery updates, and secure restaurant or event reservations. When something changes, you reshuffle the plan, notify me immediately, and lock in the new time or service. Each errand should be logged in a shared, easy-to-scan list (Google Sheets, Notion, or a simple spreadsheet—whatever you prefer, as long as it stays current). We’ll communicate almost exclusively through WhatsApp or standard text messages. Quick responses during my local business hours are important so I can approve or redirect tasks in real time. Deliverables I expect • Up-to-date tracker of all open errands with status and due dates • Confirmations or receipts forwarded as they arrive • A brief weekly summary highlighting what was completed and what’s coming up Accuracy, discretion, and proactive follow-ups are essential. If you thrive on keeping chaos under control, you’ll find this straightforward and satisfying work.

opportunities.title: Trade Show Product Booth Design
opportunities.description: I need a fresh, visually engaging booth concept for an upcoming trade show where I’ll be showcasing our physical products. The space has to do more than look good—it must guide visitors naturally toward the shelves and stands, highlight key items, and make it easy for staff to interact with prospects. The core requirements are straightforward: • A layout that maximises foot traffic flow while giving each product clear, well-lit display space. • Shelf and stand placement integrated into the overall aesthetic, so the structure never feels like an add-on. • Ready-to-use visual assets (3D renderings and a simple floor plan) that I can hand directly to our fabricators and event team. If you’re comfortable turning brand guidelines into an attention-grabbing, build-ready booth design, I’d love to see your approach and previous trade-show work.

opportunities.title: Farmhouse Plot Brochure Layout
opportunities.description: I have a parcel of land that will be split into individual farmhouse plots and now need a polished master layout that can drop straight into my sales brochure. The drawing must clearly show every plot, the internal road network, generous green spaces, and the locations earmarked for shared facilities so buyers immediately feel the development’s quality. Beyond accuracy, the artwork has to look premium—clean lines, balanced colours, and a presentation style that photographs well in print and on screen. I will rely on this single sheet to convince prospects, so legibility and curb-appeal are equally important. Please deliver: • A dimensioned, scalable base plan in a fully editable format (DWG or layered Illustrator/PSD). • A high-resolution, print-ready PDF/JPEG rendered in marketing colours. If you already use tools such as AutoCAD, Illustrator, Corel, or SketchUp for plan rendering, that aligns perfectly with the outcome I need. Turnaround can be discussed, but I would like to move quickly once you have my site measurements.

opportunities.title: Single-Family Home Architecture Design
opportunities.description: I’m ready to move forward with the complete architectural design of a new single-family home and I’m looking for a creative architect who can translate my ideas into clear, build-ready documents. The scope covers everything from initial concept sketches through detailed floor plans, elevations, sections, and, if possible, a few 3D views to help me visualise the spaces before construction begins. Please include samples of your past work on comparable residential projects when you reply—seeing what you have already delivered for other clients will help me understand your style and technical depth. My priority is a design that balances aesthetics, functionality, and cost-effective construction methods while respecting local building codes. If you have experience in energy-efficient layouts or sustainable materials, feel free to highlight that as well. Once we agree on the overall concept, I’ll need the full set of architectural drawings in both PDF and editable formats (DWG or Revit preferred), along with any supporting schedules or notes required for permit submission. Looking forward to collaborating and creating a home that feels uniquely mine while staying practical for builders and inspectors alike.

observed_data.verbatim_request: "I’m ready to move forward with the complete architectural design of a new single-family home and I’m looking for a creative architect who can translate my ideas into clear, build-ready documents. The scope covers everything from initial concept sketches through detailed floor plans, elevations, sections, and, if possible, a few 3D views to help me visualise the spaces before construction begins. Please include samples of your past work on comparable residential projects when you reply—seeing what you have already delivered for other clients will help me understand your style and technical depth. My priority is a design that balances aesthetics, functionality, and cost-effective construction methods while respecting local building codes. If you have experience in energy-efficient layouts or sustainable materials, feel free to highlight that as well. Once we agree on the overall concept, I’ll need the full set of architectural drawings in both PDF and editable formats (DWG or Revit preferred), along with any supporting schedules or notes required for permit submission. Looking forward to collaborating and creating a home that feels uniquely mine while staying practical for builders and inspectors alike."
